key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.95s): Initial archival pose of flamingo; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.08s): Mid-sequence articulation of flamingo; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.31s): Peak dynamic extension of flamingo over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.55s): Follow-through and settle of flamingo with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of flamingo (1.95s..5.55s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
